list.title: Dingwadišo
list.empty: Ga go na dingwadišo tšeo di swanago le difiltara tše.

override.title: Admin Tloša ka thoko
override.hint: Di-override di dula di logged ka boitšhupo bja gago bja admin le lebaka - le ka mohla ga di homole.
override.cancelBookingHint: Go phumola go swaya peeletšo le khomišene ya yona bjalo ka yeo e phumotšwego, go bušetša beng ba tshepedišo go molekane, gomme go dumelela moagi go beakanya ketapele ye gape.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Khansela peeletšo ye? Khomišene ya yona le yona e a phumolwa. Se se logged ka leina la gago le lebaka.

detail.timelineTitle: Mothaladi wa Nako wa Bohlahlobi (ngwadišo ye) .
detail.disputeOpen: Kgang ya beng e bulegile go moreki yo - molekane yo mongwe o re ke ya bona. E tšewa sephetho letlakaleng la Dingangišano.

cancellation.title: Booking e phumotšwe
cancellation.hint: Go beakanya le khomišene ya yona di a phumolwa; beng ba tshepedišo bo boile le molekane gomme moagi a ka beakanya go eta pele mo gape.

disputes.title: Dingangišano tša Beng
disputes.hint: Molekane yo ngwadišo ya gagwe e gannwego bjalo ka phetolelo a ka ganetša gore ke mang mong wa moreki. Boeletša mahlakore ka bobedi gomme o dire phetho.
disputes.empty: Ga go na dingangišano le maemo a.

detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} o boloka moreki. Kgang e tswaletšwe gomme ga go na selo se sengwe seo se fetogago.
